# ExifTool

Toki bundles the unmodified ExifTool 13.55 script and libraries by Phil Harvey.

- Upstream: https://exiftool.org/
- Source: https://cpan.metacpan.org/authors/id/E/EX/EXIFTOOL/Image-ExifTool-13.55.tar.gz
- SHA-256: `5f4c81d34ad406538c2871ad72dbfceb5d9b412b2f16cbbeb4d712d270846667`
- Copyright 2003–2026, Phil Harvey.
- Distributed under the Perl Artistic License; see `Artistic-1.0.txt`.

The upstream README, copyright notices, script and libraries are included in
`Toki.app/Contents/Resources/ExifTool/`. Build downloads are checksum-verified
and cached in `.build/`; Homebrew's patched executable is never bundled.
